scenarios.title: M 7.4 - 15 km S of Hualien City, Taiwan
scenarios.note: Reported = companies that publicly said production was affected and that the supplier list places in the area. 24 suppliers were put on alert in total (locations are region-level, so it over-flags). Not on the list at all: UMC, AUO, Innolux.

scenarios.title: M 7.5 - 2024 Noto Peninsula, Japan Earthquake
scenarios.note: Reported = companies that publicly said production was affected and that the supplier list places in the area. 8 suppliers were put on alert in total (locations are region-level, so it over-flags). No site in the area on the list: Japan Display. Not on the list at all: Toshiba (Kaga Toshiba Electronics), Kokusai Electric.
